text:
Tasha (Design): quick check-in on form noise in the dashboard create flow. When people paste many fields it gets very loud with inline errors. Thoughts on making validation feel calmer but still actionable?
Evan (Eng): agree it's overwhelming. Idea: show a compact top banner with counts + 1 inline highlight per section. let users opt into 'show all' for full inline errors. :gear:
Marta (PM): that would help power users. For first-time flows we should still show helpful inline hints, maybe only on blur.
Jia L: accessibility: banner must be announced (role=alert) and the "show all" toggle needs aria-expanded/controls. when jumping to a field, set focus and expose the helper text with aria-describedby.
Samir: also consider severity ordering: block errors (missing required) > format > warnings. show tiny badges so users can triage at a glance.
Tasha (Design): microcopy debate: asterisk vs explicit "Required" label. In dense tables or import UIs prefer a column-level note + header asterisk with tooltip. per-field asterisk + sr-only "required" for forms.
a11y-bot: checklist: [1] role=alert on banner, [2] aria-invalid on fields, [3] aria-describedby linking errors, [4] keyboard-focusable error list, [5] include required in accessible name.
Evan (Eng): destructive actions inside forms (e.g., "unlink credential") — prefer modal + undo toast. typed-confirm only for irreversible resources. ensure undo is keyboard accessible and server supports short TTL restoration.
Marta (PM): copy for modal primary: "Unlink credential" (explicit). toast: "Credential unlinked — Undo" (8s). keep it short.
Jia L: modal accessibility: heading announced, body with consequences, focus trap. put primary CTA after the explanatory text in tab order so screen reader users hear the context first.
Tasha (Design): I'll prototype two variants: 1) banner + prioritized inline with "show all"; 2) per-field collapsed helpers with severity badges. will post mocks + copy + a11y notes by EOD.
Samir: great — ping when ready for dev review. :thumbsup:
